The same hinge tokens stay near zero when the clause is about people, institutions, everyday domestic activity or commerce (e.g. 'The children will operate...', 'I actually forgot...'), and the peak is independent of which word follows: swapping the following verb or noun leaves the activation unchanged, whereas swapping the subject noun moves it by 2+ units.
